recipes.name: Birria Beef Tacos
steps: Remove the stems and seeds from 4 guajillo and 2 ancho chiles. Cover with hot water for 15 minutes; drain and blend with half of the onion, 4 garlic cloves, 2 tbsp vinegar, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tsp cumin, and 1 cup of the beef broth until smooth.

Cut 2 lb beef chuck into large pieces and place in a heavy pot. Pour in the chile sauce and remaining 2 cups of broth. Bring to a gentle simmer, cover, and cook over low heat for 3–3½ hours, checking occasionally, until the beef shreds easily with a fork.

Transfer beef to a board, shred finely, and return a few spoonfuls of the braising liquid to keep it juicy. Skim excess fat from the top of the pot and reserve some of the reddish fat for crisping tortillas.

Warm a skillet over medium heat. Dip each of 12 corn tortillas lightly into the top of the braising liquid, place on the skillet, and add shredded beef and some of the 1½ cups Oaxaca cheese. Fold and cook 2–3 minutes per side until golden and the cheese melts.
Serve three tacos per person with diced remaining onion, ¼ cup chopped cilantro, and wedges from 2 limes. Ladle the hot strained braising liquid into small bowls for dipping.

recipes.name: Carne Asada Street Tacos
steps: Whisk ¼ cup orange juice, ¼ cup lime juice, 2 tbsp olive oil, 3 minced garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp chili powder, and 1 tsp salt in a shallow dish. Add 1½ lb flank steak, coat, cover, and refrigerate for 30 minutes to 4 hours.

Heat a clean grill or heavy skillet to medium-high. Remove steak from marinade and discard used marinade. Grill the steak 4–6 minutes per side, adjusting for thickness, until the thickest part reaches at least 145°F; rest on a board for 3 minutes.
While the steak rests, warm 12 corn tortillas on a dry skillet for 20–30 seconds per side. Finely dice half a white onion and chop ¼ cup cilantro.
Slice steak thinly against the grain, then chop into bite-sized pieces. Divide evenly among tortillas, about three tacos per serving.
Top with diced onion and cilantro and serve with wedges cut from 2 limes. Add cooking juices from the rested steak over the meat just before serving.

recipes.name: Slow-Cooker Pork Carnitas
steps: Trim large exterior fat caps from 3 lb pork shoulder and cut the meat into 3–4 big pieces. Rub evenly with 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp oregano, and 1½ tsp salt.

Spread sliced onion and 4 crushed garlic cloves in the slow cooker. Add pork pieces, ½ cup orange juice, ½ cup chicken broth, and juice from 1 lime. Cover and cook on LOW for 8–9 hours or HIGH for 5–6 hours, until the pork is tender and reaches at least 145°F.
Lift the pork into a dish and shred with two forks, discarding large pieces of fat. Reserve ½ cup of its cooking liquid and toss it with the shredded meat.
Spread one-third of the pork on a sheet pan in a thin layer and broil 3–5 minutes until the tips begin to crisp, watching closely. Repeat with the remaining meat so it crisps instead of steaming.
Warm 18 corn tortillas. Divide carnitas among them and serve with the remaining lime cut into wedges and ¼ cup chopped cilantro. Refrigerate leftover pork promptly in shallow containers.

recipes.name: Crispy Chicken Tostadas
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Brush 8 corn tortillas lightly with 1 tbsp olive oil, place on two baking sheets, and bake for 8–12 minutes, flipping halfway, until dry and crisp; check often so they do not burn.

Slice 1 lb chicken breasts into thin strips and toss with 1 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp cumin, and ½ tsp salt. Heat remaining 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high and cook chicken for 6–8 minutes, stirring, until the thickest pieces reach 165°F.
Warm 1 cup refried beans in a small saucepan over medium-low heat for 3–4 minutes, stirring, until steaming. Dice 2 tomatoes and cut 1 lime into wedges.
Spread roughly 2 tbsp hot beans over each crisp tortilla. Divide chicken across the eight tostadas and top with 2 cups shredded lettuce, tomatoes, and 1 cup Monterey Jack cheese.
Spoon ½ cup sour cream across the tostadas and finish with lime juice. Serve two tostadas per person immediately so the shells stay crisp.

recipes.name: Beef Barbacoa Bowls
steps: Blend 2 chipotle peppers, 1 cup beef broth, 2 tbsp vinegar, 4 garlic cloves, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp oregano, and 1½ tsp salt into a smooth sauce. Cut 2½ lb chuck roast into four large pieces.
Put the beef and sauce into a slow cooker. Cover and cook on LOW 8–9 hours until the meat is tender and pulls apart easily. Shred the beef and stir it into the cooking juices.
About 30 minutes before serving, rinse 1½ cups dry rice. Cook according to package directions with the measured water, then fluff and divide into six bowls.
Drain and rinse enough canned black beans for 2 cups. Heat beans in a small saucepan over medium heat for 4–5 minutes until steaming. Wash and chop 3 cups romaine lettuce.
Top each bowl with barbacoa, warm beans, chopped lettuce, and a squeeze of lime from 2 limes. Offer extra braising juices separately.

recipes.name: Creamy Roasted Poblano Mac and Cheese
steps: Roast 3 poblanos under broiler until charred, steam covered 10 minutes then peel, seed and chop
Heat oven to 375°F and boil 12 oz macaroni until just tender; drain
Melt 3 tbsp butter, whisk in 3 tbsp flour for 1 minute, slowly whisk in 2 cups milk and cook until thick
Melt in 2 cups cheddar, stir in diced poblanos and macaroni
Transfer to baking dish, sprinkle ½ cup breadcrumbs and bake 15–20 minutes until bubbly

recipes.name: Ground Beef Taco Skillet
steps: Dice 1 onion and 1 bell pepper. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium heat; cook the onion and pepper for 4–5 minutes, stirring, until softened.
Add 1 lb lean ground beef and break it into small pieces with a spoon. Cook for 7–9 minutes until no pink remains and the meat reaches 160°F; drain excess fat.

Stir in 2 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp cumin, and ½ tsp salt. Add 1 cup drained black beans, 1 cup canned diced tomatoes with their juices, and 1 cup frozen corn. Simmer uncovered 8–10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are hot and the sauce thickens.
Scatter 1 cup shredded cheddar over the skillet. Cover for 2–3 minutes until the cheese melts, then turn off the heat and let stand 2 minutes.
Warm 8 corn tortillas in a separate dry skillet for about 30 seconds per side. Spoon the beef mixture into tortillas, two per person, or serve in bowls.

recipes.name: Chicken Tinga Tacos
steps: Slice 1 onion thinly and mince 3 garlic cloves. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a deep skillet over medium heat. Cook onion for about 5 minutes until soft, then stir in garlic for 30 seconds.
Blend 1½ cups crushed tomatoes, 1 chipotle pepper, ½ cup broth, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tsp cumin, and ¾ tsp salt. Pour the mixture into the skillet and bring to a gentle simmer.
Nestle 1½ lb chicken thighs into the sauce. Cover and simmer 18–25 minutes, turning once, until the chicken reaches 165°F and shreds easily.
Transfer the chicken to a plate, shred using two forks, and return to the sauce. Cook uncovered another 3–5 minutes to thicken, stirring so the chicken is evenly coated.
Warm 12 tortillas in a dry skillet for 20–30 seconds per side. Fill with the tinga mixture and sprinkle with ¼ cup chopped cilantro. Serve three tacos per person.

recipes.name: Steak Fajita Quesadillas
steps: Slice 1¼ lb flank steak against the grain into thin strips. Toss with 2 tbsp lime juice, 2 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp garlic powder and ¾ tsp salt, then refrigerate while you prepare the vegetables.

Cut the 2 bell peppers and 1 onion into thin strips. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a wide skillet over medium-high heat and cook the vegetables for 6–8 minutes, stirring until softened and slightly browned; transfer to a plate.

Add the remaining 1 tbsp oil to the skillet. Cook the steak in two batches for about 3–5 minutes per batch, stirring occasionally, until the thickest pieces reach 145°F. Rest the steak for at least 3 minutes before assembling.

Lay out 8 flour tortillas. Sprinkle ¼ cup Monterey Jack cheese on each of four tortillas, then divide the steak and peppers evenly among them. Sprinkle the remaining cheese over the filling and cover with the other four tortillas.
Cook each quesadilla in a clean skillet over medium heat for about 2–3 minutes per side until golden and cheese melts. Slice each into wedges and serve one filled quesadilla per person.

recipes.name: Shrimp Fajita Rice Bowls
steps: Rinse 1 cup dry long-grain rice and cook it with the package-directed amount of water until tender, about 15–20 minutes. Keep covered off heat for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Cut 2 bell peppers and 1 red onion into strips. Toss the prepared shrimp with 2 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp garlic powder, and ¾ tsp salt in a separate bowl.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the peppers and onion for 6–8 minutes until crisp-tender, then transfer to a plate.

Add the remaining tablespoon of oil to the skillet. Arrange the shrimp in a single layer and cook 2–3 minutes per side, turning once, until the flesh is opaque, firm, and reaches 145°F; return the vegetables to the skillet briefly to warm through.
Divide the rice among four bowls. Top evenly with shrimp and peppers, ½ cup salsa, ¼ cup chopped cilantro and lime wedges from 2 limes. Serve immediately while the shrimp are tender.

recipes.name: Smothered Beef Burritos
steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F. Dice 1 yellow onion. Warm 2 cups previously cooked rice and 1 cup refried beans separately until steaming, following safe storage and reheating instructions for cooked rice.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook the onion for 4 minutes, then add 1 lb ground beef and break it up. Cook until browned and the center reaches 160°F; drain any excess fat.
Stir 2 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp cumin and ½ tsp salt into the beef. Spread ½ cup enchilada sauce across the bottom of a 9-by-13-inch baking dish.
Fill four large tortillas evenly with rice, beans, beef mixture and ½ cup shredded cheddar. Fold the sides in and roll tightly, then place seam-side down in the baking dish.

Pour the remaining 1½ cups sauce over the burritos, scatter the remaining 1 cup cheddar on top and bake uncovered 15–20 minutes until bubbling and the centers reach 165°F. Divide ½ cup sour cream across four servings.

recipes.name: Chicken Chimichangas
steps: Preheat the oven to 425°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment and brush lightly with 1 tsp from the measured olive oil.
In a large bowl, combine 3 cups fully cooked shredded chicken, ½ cup salsa, ¼ cup drained green chiles, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp chili powder and 1½ cups Monterey Jack cheese. Stir until evenly coated.
Warm four flour tortillas briefly so they bend without tearing. Place one quarter of the filling in the center of each tortilla; fold in the sides and roll into tight, closed parcels.

Put chimichangas seam-side down on the tray and brush the exposed surfaces with the remaining olive oil. Bake 18–22 minutes, turning carefully once, until crisp and golden and the fillings reach 165°F.
Allow the chimichangas to rest for 3 minutes. Serve one per person with ½ cup sour cream divided among them and 1 cup shredded lettuce.

recipes.name: Tex-Mex Beef Stuffed Peppers
steps: Preheat the oven to 375°F. Slice the tops off four bell peppers, remove seeds and membranes, and place them upright in a baking dish with ¼ cup water at the bottom.

Finely dice half a yellow onion. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook onion for 3–4 minutes. Add 1 lb ground beef, breaking it apart, and cook until the meat reaches 160°F; drain excess fat.
Mix beef and onion with 1½ cups safely reheated cooked rice, 1 cup rinsed black beans, 1 cup diced tomatoes, 2 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp cumin and ½ tsp salt. Simmer 3 minutes to combine flavors.
Divide the beef and rice mixture among the four peppers, pressing down gently. Cover the baking dish with foil and bake for 30 minutes until peppers begin to soften.

Remove foil, top evenly with 1 cup shredded cheddar and bake for another 10–15 minutes until peppers are tender, cheese melts and the centers reach 165°F. Rest 5 minutes before serving one pepper per person.

recipes.name: Cheesy Taco Pasta
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add 12 oz dry elbow macaroni and cook until just firm, following package directions; reserve ½ cup pasta water, then drain.

Meanwhile finely dice 1 yellow onion. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large deep skillet over medium heat and sauté onion 4 minutes. Add 1 lb ground beef and cook 7–9 minutes until it reaches 160°F, breaking it into small pieces; drain excess fat.
Stir 2 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp garlic powder and ¾ tsp salt into the beef. Add 2 cups crushed tomatoes and 1 cup beef broth, then simmer uncovered for 7 minutes.

Fold cooked macaroni into the sauce and stir gently until coated. If too thick, add a few spoonfuls of the reserved pasta water. Sprinkle in 2 cups shredded cheddar in portions, stirring after each addition until melted.
Turn off heat and fold in ½ cup sour cream. Rest 3 minutes so the sauce thickens, then divide into six bowls and serve warm.

recipes.name: Pork Chile Verde
steps: Remove papery husks from 1½ lb tomatillos and rinse thoroughly. Halve them, 2 poblanos, 2 jalapeños and 1 onion; place on a baking sheet with 4 peeled garlic cloves and broil 6–10 minutes, turning once, until lightly blistered. Remove pepper seeds for a milder sauce.

Blend the roasted vegetables with 1 cup of the chicken broth, ½ cup cilantro, 1½ tsp cumin and 1 tsp oregano until mostly smooth. Work in batches and vent the blender lid when handling hot ingredients.
Cut 2½ lb pork shoulder into roughly 2-inch cubes and season with 1½ tsp salt. Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a heavy pot and brown the pork in two batches, 3–4 minutes per side, without crowding.

Return all pork to the pot with the green sauce and remaining ½ cup broth. Bring to a gentle simmer, cover partially and cook on low for 1½–2 hours, stirring occasionally, until the pork is tender enough to pull apart easily.
Taste the sauce and adjust seasoning if needed. Squeeze in juice of 1 lime and simmer uncovered 5 more minutes to thicken. Divide among six bowls with cooking juices and serve hot.

recipes.name: Pork and Hominy Green Chile Skillet
steps: Cut 1½ lb pork shoulder into ½-inch cubes and cook in a covered skillet with 1 cup broth over low heat for 45 minutes
Uncover, increase to medium and simmer until liquid almost evaporates
Add diced onion and 3 minced garlic cloves, cook 5 minutes
Stir in two drained 15 oz cans hominy, 2 cups salsa verde and 1 tsp cumin
Cover and cook 20–25 minutes until pork is tender and reaches at least 145°F; rest 3 minutes before serving

recipes.name: Chicken Pozole Verde
steps: Husk and rinse 1 lb tomatillos, then quarter them. Seed and chop 2 poblano peppers, dice 1 onion and mince 3 garlic cloves; keep half the diced onion for garnish.

Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large soup pot over medium heat. Sauté half the onion and the poblanos for 5 minutes, then add garlic for 30 seconds. Add tomatillos, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp oregano and 2 cups of broth; simmer 12–15 minutes until tomatillos soften.
Carefully blend the cooked vegetables with their cooking liquid until smooth, venting the blender lid for steam. Return to the pot with the other 4 cups broth, 1½ lb chicken thighs and 1 tsp salt.
Bring to a gentle simmer, cover and cook 20–25 minutes until the chicken reaches 165°F. Remove chicken, shred using forks and return it to the soup with 3 cups drained hominy.
Simmer 10 minutes more until hominy is hot. Ladle into six bowls and serve with 2 cups shredded cabbage, ½ cup cilantro, reserved diced onion and wedges from 2 limes.

recipes.name: Pork Pozole Rojo
steps: Remove stems and seeds from 4 guajillo and 2 ancho chiles. Cover them with hot water for 15 minutes until pliable, then drain; blend with 1 cup chicken broth and 4 peeled garlic cloves until smooth.
Cut 2 lb boneless pork shoulder into roughly 1½-inch cubes. Dice half a white onion and put it in a heavy soup pot with the pork, remaining 6 cups broth, 2 tsp oregano, 1 tsp cumin and 1½ tsp salt.
Bring to a gentle simmer, cover partially and cook about 60 minutes, stirring occasionally and skimming the surface, until pork begins to become tender.
Pour the blended chile sauce through a fine sieve into the pot, pressing gently to extract the sauce. Continue simmering 30–45 minutes, until pork is fork-tender, then stir in 3 cups drained hominy.

Simmer another 10–15 minutes until the hominy is hot. Taste and adjust seasoning; serve six bowls with 2 cups shredded cabbage, 6 thinly sliced radishes, the remaining finely diced onion and wedges from 2 limes.

recipes.name: Mexican Street Corn Chicken Bowls
steps: Cook 1 cup dry rice according to its package directions until tender. Let rest covered for 5 minutes, then fluff and set aside while the chicken and corn finish.

Mix 1 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp garlic powder and ¾ tsp salt. Rub the mixture over 1¼ lb chicken breasts. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook chicken 5–7 minutes per side, depending on thickness, until the center reaches 165°F; rest 5 minutes before slicing.
Heat the remaining tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add 2 cups corn kernels and cook 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until hot and lightly charred.
Whisk ¼ cup mayonnaise, ¼ cup sour cream, juice of 1 lime and remaining 1 tsp chili powder. Toss the hot corn with half this sauce and ½ cup crumbled Cotija cheese.
Divide rice into four bowls, top with sliced chicken and dressed corn and drizzle the remaining sauce over each serving. Finish with ¼ cup chopped cilantro and wedges from the second lime.

recipes.name: Citrus Shrimp and Avocado Ceviche Cups
steps: Verify 1½ lb shrimp are fully cooked to 145°F, then chill below 40°F
Dice cooked shrimp, 2 avocados, 1 cucumber and ½ red onion into small pieces
Juice 4 limes and 1 orange into a clean bowl
Fold shrimp, vegetables, juice and ¼ cup chopped cilantro together; refrigerate covered for 15 minutes
Divide into four chilled lettuce-free appetizer cups and serve promptly

recipes.name: Steak Nacho Supreme
steps: Heat oven to 400°F and line a large baking sheet with parchment. Drain and rinse 1 cup black beans, dice 2 tomatoes, slice 1 avocado, and cut 1 lime into wedges.

Pat 1¼ lb flank steak dry and season with 1 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp cumin, and ½ tsp salt. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a heavy skillet over medium-high heat and sear steak roughly 4–6 minutes per side, depending on thickness, until the center reaches 145°F; rest for at least 3 minutes.

Slice the rested steak thinly against the grain. Spread 8 oz tortilla chips in a single layer on the prepared sheet and scatter the drained beans, steak slices, and 1½ cups cheddar evenly over the chips.
Bake 7–10 minutes, until the chips are hot and the cheese melts, checking frequently to prevent burning. Remove the pan from the oven and place it on a heat-safe surface.
Scatter diced tomato and ¼ cup pickled jalapeños over the nachos. Add avocado and dollops from ½ cup sour cream, then divide into four portions and serve immediately with lime wedges.

recipes.name: Pulled Pork Nachos
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F and line a large rimmed sheet pan with parchment. Drain and rinse 1 cup black beans, thinly dice half a red onion, and chop ¼ cup fresh cilantro.

Put 1½ lb fully cooked pulled pork into a saucepan with ½ cup barbecue sauce and 2 tbsp water. Heat over medium-low for 6–8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the meat is steaming and reaches 165°F.
Spread 8 oz tortilla chips over the sheet pan in an even layer. Distribute the hot pulled pork and drained black beans evenly over the chips and sprinkle 1½ cups Monterey Jack cheese over everything.
Bake 6–9 minutes, just until the cheese melts and the nachos are heated through; watch closely because exposed chips can brown quickly.
Remove from the oven and top with diced onion, ¼ cup pickled jalapeños, ½ cup sour cream, and chopped cilantro. Cut 1 lime into wedges and serve the nachos in four portions while crisp.

recipes.name: Beef and Potato Taquitos
steps: Peel and cut 1 lb russet potatoes into small cubes. Put them in a saucepan, cover with water, bring to a simmer, and cook 10–12 minutes until fork-tender; drain thoroughly and roughly mash.
Dice half a yellow onion. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook onion for 3 minutes. Add ¾ lb ground beef, breaking it apart, and cook until it reaches 160°F; drain excess fat.
Stir 1 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp cumin, ½ tsp garlic powder and ¾ tsp salt into the beef. Combine with mashed potatoes and 1 cup shredded cheddar until evenly mixed.

Heat the oven to 425°F and brush a baking sheet with 1 tbsp olive oil. Warm 12 corn tortillas between damp paper towels briefly until pliable, divide filling among them, roll tightly, and arrange seam-side down.

Brush the tops of the rolls with remaining 1 tbsp olive oil. Bake 16–20 minutes, turning halfway, until crisp and hot through. Serve three taquitos per person with ½ cup salsa divided among the four plates.

recipes.name: Crispy Chicken Flautas
steps: Preheat oven to 425°F and lightly grease a large baking sheet with 1 tbsp olive oil. Dice 2 tomatoes and wash and dry 2 cups shredded lettuce for the topping.
Mix 3 cups fully cooked shredded chicken with ½ cup salsa verde, 1 cup Monterey Jack cheese, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp chili powder and ¼ tsp salt until the filling is evenly moistened.
Warm 12 fajita-size flour tortillas until pliable. Place an even strip of the chicken mixture near one edge of each tortilla and roll as tightly as possible into narrow tubes.

Place flautas seam-side down on the sheet without touching. Brush the tops and sides with the remaining 2 tbsp olive oil, then bake 16–20 minutes, turning once after about 10 minutes, until deep golden and the centers reach 165°F.
Allow the flautas to cool for 2 minutes so the crisp shells set. Divide into four portions of three, and top each with shredded lettuce, diced tomato and a share of ½ cup sour cream.

recipes.name: Mexican Picadillo
steps: Scrub and peel 1 lb potatoes, then dice into ½-inch cubes. Peel and dice 2 carrots, finely chop 1 yellow onion and 3 garlic cloves, and cut 3 Roma tomatoes into small pieces.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large deep skillet over medium heat. Cook onion and carrot for 4 minutes, stirring occasionally, then add garlic and cook 30 seconds.
Add 1 lb ground beef, break it into small crumbles, and cook 7–9 minutes until no pink remains and a thermometer reads 160°F. Drain excess fat if necessary.

Stir in potatoes, tomatoes, 1 cup beef broth, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp oregano, ¾ tsp salt and ¼ tsp pepper. Bring to a gentle simmer, cover, and cook for 15–20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until potatoes are tender.
Add ½ cup frozen peas and simmer uncovered for another 4–5 minutes, until the vegetables are heated through and the sauce thickens slightly. Divide evenly among four plates or bowls and serve hot.

recipes.name: Salsa Verde Chicken Tacos
steps: Finely dice half a white onion and mince 2 garlic cloves. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a heavy skillet over medium heat, then sauté onion for 3–4 minutes until softened and stir in garlic for 30 seconds.
Add 1½ lb chicken thighs to the skillet and sprinkle with 1 tsp cumin and ½ tsp salt. Pour 1½ cups salsa verde and ½ cup chicken broth around the chicken; bring to a gentle simmer.

Cover and cook 18–25 minutes, turning the chicken halfway through, until the thickest pieces reach 165°F and shred easily. Remove the chicken to a cutting board, shred using two forks and return the meat to its sauce.
Simmer the shredded chicken uncovered 3–5 minutes until coated with a slightly thickened sauce. Warm 12 corn tortillas in a dry skillet for 20–30 seconds per side.
Divide the chicken among the tortillas, three tacos per person. Top with 1 cup shredded lettuce, ¼ cup chopped cilantro and wedges from 2 limes, then serve while hot.

recipes.name: Beef and Cheese Empanadas
steps: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Finely dice 1 onion and 1 red bell pepper and sauté for 5–6 minutes until soft; add 2 minced garlic cloves for the final 30 seconds.

Add 1 lb lean ground beef and break into fine crumbles. Cook about 7–9 minutes until browned and at least 160°F, then drain excess liquid and season with 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika and ¾ tsp salt.
Transfer the filling to a bowl and let it cool until no longer steaming. Stir in 1 cup shredded Monterey Jack cheese. Heat the oven to 400°F and line two baking sheets with parchment.
Place 12 empanada dough discs on a clean surface. Spoon about 2 tablespoons filling in the center of each disc, fold each one into a half-moon shape, and seal the edges tightly with fork tines.

Beat 1 egg with 1 tbsp water and brush lightly over each empanada. Bake 20–25 minutes, switching tray positions halfway through, until deeply golden and the filling is heated through; serve two per person after resting 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Cornbread Crusted Turkey Tamale Pie
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and brown 1½ lb ground turkey in a deep oven-safe skillet until 165°F
Stir in 1 drained can beans, 14 oz tomatoes and 1 tbsp chili powder and simmer 5 minutes
Whisk 1 cup cornmeal, ½ cup flour, 1 cup milk and 1 egg into a spoonable batter
Spread 1 cup cheddar over turkey filling, then carefully spoon cornbread batter on top
Bake uncovered 25–30 minutes until topping is set and golden, then rest 5 minutes before serving

recipes.name: Chipotle Chicken Torta
steps: Finely chop 2 chipotle peppers and whisk with ¼ cup mayonnaise and 2 tbsp lime juice to make the spread. Slice 2 tomatoes and 1 avocado, rinse the lettuce, and split 4 bolillo rolls lengthwise.

Pat 1¼ lb chicken breasts dry, then season with 1 tsp cumin and ¾ tsp salt. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and cook the breasts for 5–7 minutes per side, depending on thickness, until a thermometer reads 165°F.
Transfer the chicken to a clean cutting board and rest for 5 minutes, then slice thinly across the grain. Meanwhile warm 1 cup refried beans in a saucepan until thoroughly steaming.

Place the split rolls cut-side up on a baking sheet, spread the lower halves with warm beans and top with equal portions of chicken and 1 oz Monterey Jack per sandwich. Broil for 1–2 minutes, watching continuously, until the cheese melts and the bread edges toast.
Spread the chipotle mayonnaise on the upper roll halves; layer the warm chicken with sliced avocado, tomatoes and 1 cup shredded lettuce. Close each torta, press gently and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Shrimp Veracruz
steps: Cook 1 cup dry long-grain rice according to its package instructions. While it cooks, dice 1 onion, mince 3 garlic cloves, thinly slice ½ cup green olives, and finely chop 1 jalapeño, removing seeds if milder heat is desired.
Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a deep skillet over medium heat and cook the onion for 5–6 minutes until softened. Stir in garlic and jalapeño for 30 seconds without browning the garlic.

Add 2 cups crushed tomatoes, ½ cup sliced olives, 2 tbsp drained capers, 1 tsp oregano, one bay leaf and ½ tsp salt. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook uncovered 10–12 minutes, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened.

Pat 1½ lb raw shrimp dry and nestle them into the simmering tomato sauce. Cook for about 4–6 minutes, turning halfway, until shrimp are opaque and firm and the thickest shrimp reaches 145°F; discard the bay leaf.
Squeeze juice from 1 lime into the sauce and stir gently. Divide rice among four plates and spoon shrimp and Veracruz-style tomato-olive sauce evenly over each portion.

recipes.name: Steak and Pinto Bean Burritos
steps: Thinly slice 1¼ lb flank steak against the grain and toss with 2 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp cumin, ¾ tsp salt and juice from 1 lime. Slice 1 bell pepper and 1 onion into thin strips.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sauté the sliced pepper and onion for about 6–8 minutes until softened and lightly browned; transfer vegetables to a plate.

Add the remaining tablespoon of oil to the skillet and cook steak strips in batches so the pan does not crowd, about 3–5 minutes per batch, until the thickest pieces reach 145°F; rest at least 3 minutes before serving.

Heat 1½ cups previously cooked rice and 1½ cups cooked pinto beans separately until steaming; use properly refrigerated rice and reheat to 165°F. Warm 4 large flour tortillas briefly on a dry skillet until pliable.
Divide rice, beans, steak, sautéed vegetables, 1 cup shredded cheddar and ½ cup salsa evenly among tortillas. Fold the sides inward, roll each burrito tightly and serve warm.

recipes.name: Poblano Chicken Rice Bake
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and grease a deep 9-by-13-inch baking dish lightly. Seed and dice 3 poblano peppers, dice 1 onion, mince 3 garlic cloves and cut 1½ lb chicken breasts into even bite-size pieces.

Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium heat, then cook onion and poblano peppers for 5–6 minutes until starting to soften. Add garlic for 30 seconds and transfer the vegetables to the prepared baking dish.

Add remaining 1 tbsp oil to the skillet, then sear chicken pieces in two batches for 2 minutes per side to build color; the chicken will finish cooking in the oven. Season chicken with 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp chili powder and 1 tsp salt.
Add 1½ cups dry long-grain rice, 1 cup drained tomatoes, chicken and vegetables to the baking dish, and stir evenly. Pour over 3 cups hot chicken broth, cover tightly with foil and bake 35 minutes.

Carefully remove foil and check rice for tenderness and liquid absorption; cook covered 5–10 minutes more if needed. Verify every chicken piece reaches 165°F, sprinkle 1½ cups Monterey Jack over the dish, and return uncovered for 5 minutes to melt the cheese. Rest 5 minutes and finish with ¼ cup chopped cilantro before serving six portions.

recipes.name: Mexican Beef Stuffed Zucchini
steps: Preheat the oven to 400°F. Slice 4 zucchini lengthwise and use a spoon to scoop out the soft centers, leaving sturdy ¼-inch shells. Arrange the eight halves cut-side up in a lightly oiled baking dish and chop the scooped flesh.

Finely dice half an onion and mince 2 garlic cloves. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté onion for 3 minutes; add the chopped zucchini flesh and garlic and cook 2 minutes more.

Add 1 lb lean ground beef, breaking it apart with a wooden spoon, and cook 7–9 minutes until fully browned and the center reaches 160°F. Drain excess fat, then add 2 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp cumin and ½ tsp salt.

Stir in 1 cup cooked rice, 1 cup drained black beans and 1 cup drained diced tomatoes. Heat the mixture until steaming, then spoon evenly into the eight zucchini boats. Cover tightly with foil and bake 20 minutes.

Remove foil, sprinkle 1 cup shredded cheddar evenly over the boats and bake another 8–12 minutes until the zucchini is fork-tender, the cheese melts and the filling reaches 165°F. Rest 3 minutes and garnish with ¼ cup chopped cilantro before serving two halves per person.

recipes.name: Pork Al Pastor Tacos
steps: Remove stems and seeds from 3 dried guajillo chiles, cover with hot water and soak for 15 minutes; drain. Blend softened chiles with ½ cup pineapple juice, 2 tbsp achiote paste, 2 tbsp vinegar, 3 garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp oregano and 1 tsp salt until smooth.

Trim visible excess fat from 2 lb pork shoulder and slice into ½-inch strips. Coat thoroughly with the prepared marinade in a covered dish and refrigerate at least 2 hours, preferably overnight; keep raw meat and its marinade refrigerated.

Heat oven to 375°F. Arrange pork in a roasting pan in a shallow, even layer, cover tightly with foil and roast about 45–60 minutes, until the pieces are tender and reach at least 145°F. Rest 3 minutes and reserve only fully cooked pan juices.

Uncover the pan, stir in 1 cup pineapple chunks and broil 3–5 minutes, watching continuously, until the edges of the pork and pineapple begin to caramelize. Chop the cooked pork and pineapple into small taco-size pieces.

Warm 18 corn tortillas in a dry skillet, about 20 seconds per side. Divide pork and pineapple across the tortillas; finish with diced white onion, ½ cup chopped cilantro and lime wedges, giving each person three tacos.

Arrange poblano halves cut side up and divide filling among eight halves

Serve two pepper halves per person after resting 5 minutes

recipes.name: Beef Quesabirria
steps: Remove stems and seeds from 4 guajillo and 2 ancho chiles, cover with hot water and soak 15 minutes. Drain and blend with half an onion, 4 garlic cloves, 2 tbsp vinegar, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tsp cumin and 1 cup beef broth until very smooth.

Cut 2½ lb chuck roast into large chunks and season with 1½ tsp salt. Put beef, chile sauce and remaining 2 cups beef broth in a heavy covered pot; simmer gently for 3–4 hours, turning meat occasionally, until it shreds easily with two forks.

Lift beef out, shred finely and stir in several spoonfuls of hot cooking liquid. Skim a little of the orange-red fat from the surface of the braising broth into a shallow bowl and keep the remaining broth hot to serve as consommé.

Heat a heavy nonstick skillet over medium heat. Lightly dip each of 18 corn tortillas in the skimmed broth fat, lay flat in the skillet, sprinkle with the measured Oaxaca cheese and a share of shredded beef, fold and cook 2–3 minutes per side until crisp and the cheese melts.

Serve three quesabirria tacos per person with diced remaining onion, ½ cup chopped cilantro, lime wedges and small bowls of hot strained braising broth for dipping. Refrigerate leftover beef and consommé promptly.

recipes.name: Tex-Mex Chili Mac
steps: Dice 1 onion and mince 3 garlic cloves; drain and rinse 1½ cups kidney beans, measure 12 oz dry elbow macaroni and set out the remaining ingredients.

Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a deep skillet or Dutch oven over medium heat; sauté onion for 4–5 minutes, add garlic for 30 seconds, then add 1 lb ground beef and cook while breaking it apart until it reaches 160°F; drain excess fat.
Stir in 2 tbsp tomato paste, 2 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika and ½ tsp salt; cook for 1 minute, then add 2 cups diced tomatoes, 1½ cups broth and the beans.

Bring a separate large pot of water to a boil, cook the 12 oz macaroni according to package directions until barely al dente, reserve ½ cup cooking water, and drain; meanwhile simmer the beef mixture uncovered for 8–10 minutes.
Fold macaroni into the chili mixture, adding reserved pasta water a spoonful at a time if necessary; sprinkle with 1½ cups cheddar, cover for 2 minutes until melted and divide into six warm portions.

recipes.name: Cheesy Chorizo Breakfast Tacos
steps: Finely dice half an onion and 1 bell pepper, chop ¼ cup cilantro, and crack 8 eggs into a bowl; whisk with ¼ tsp salt until whites and yolks are combined.
Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat, sauté the onion and pepper for 4–5 minutes, and transfer them to a clean plate.
Add 12 oz raw Mexican-style chorizo to the skillet, breaking it into small crumbles; cook thoroughly for 7–9 minutes until the pork chorizo reaches 160°F, then drain excess rendered fat if needed.
Lower the heat to medium-low, return the vegetables to the skillet and add the beaten eggs; stir slowly until eggs are softly set and fully cooked to 160°F, taking care not to dry them out.

Warm 8 tortillas in a dry skillet for 20 seconds on each side, divide the chorizo-egg mixture among them, add 1 cup Monterey Jack cheese and top with ½ cup salsa and cilantro; serve two tacos per person.

recipes.name: Chorizo and Potato Burritos
steps: Peel 1 lb russet potatoes and cut into even ½-inch cubes, then dice half a yellow onion; pat the potatoes dry to help them brown instead of steaming.

Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a wide skillet over medium heat and cook potato cubes and onion with ½ tsp cumin and ½ tsp salt, covered for the first 8 minutes then uncovered for another 8–10 minutes, until potatoes are tender and browned.
Transfer the potatoes to a plate; crumble 12 oz raw pork chorizo into the skillet, cook over medium heat for 7–9 minutes until it reaches 160°F and drain excess grease.
Beat 4 eggs and pour them into the cooked chorizo over medium-low heat, stirring until the eggs are fully cooked; return potatoes to the pan and toss briefly with the chorizo and eggs.

Warm four large tortillas until pliable, divide the filling evenly, sprinkle with 1 cup cheddar and spoon on ½ cup salsa verde; fold sides inward and roll tightly, then toast the wrapped burritos seam-side down for 1–2 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Grilled Fish Baja Tacos
steps: Pat dry 1½ lb skinless white fish fillets and cut into roughly eight even pieces; whisk 1 tbsp olive oil with 1 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp cumin, ½ tsp garlic powder and ¾ tsp salt, then coat the fish.
Whisk ½ cup plain Greek yogurt with juice from 1 lime and 1 tbsp water to make a pourable sauce; prepare 2 cups shredded cabbage, dice 1 avocado and chop ¼ cup cilantro.
Preheat a clean, lightly oiled grill pan over medium-high heat; brush with the remaining tablespoon of olive oil and lay the fish pieces in a single layer without crowding.
Cook fish about 3–5 minutes per side, depending on thickness, until opaque, flaky and 145°F in the thickest part; use a wide spatula to keep the pieces intact and transfer to a clean platter.

Warm 12 corn tortillas on a dry skillet, divide fish into tortillas, top with cabbage, avocado and cilantro, and drizzle with lime-yogurt sauce; serve three tacos per person with wedges from the remaining lime.

recipes.name: Creamy Chicken Poblano Soup
steps: Set oven to broil and place 3 whole poblanos on a foil-lined sheet pan. Broil 4–6 minutes per side until the skins blister, then cover the peppers in a bowl for 10 minutes, peel away loose blackened skin, discard the seeds and chop the flesh.

Dice 1 onion and 1 lb peeled potatoes, and mince 3 garlic cloves. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil over medium heat in a large soup pot, cook the onion for 4 minutes, add the garlic for 30 seconds and stir in 1 tsp cumin.

Pour 5 cups chicken broth into the pot and add potatoes, roasted poblano strips and 1¼ lb chicken breasts. Bring to a gentle simmer, cover partially and cook 18–25 minutes until the potatoes are tender and the chicken reaches 165°F.

Lift chicken onto a clean board and shred with two forks. Mash several pieces of potato directly in the pot to thicken the soup naturally, then return chicken and add 1 cup frozen corn. Simmer for 5 minutes until the corn is fully heated.

Lower the heat and stir in ¾ cup heavy cream, 1 tsp salt and ½ tsp pepper; warm gently for 3 minutes without hard boiling. Finish with the juice of 1 lime and ¼ cup chopped cilantro, then divide into six bowls.

recipes.name: Mexican Beef Meatballs
steps: Finely grate half of 1 onion and mince 1 garlic clove. In a bowl gently combine 1½ lb ground beef, 1 egg, ½ cup breadcrumbs, grated onion, garlic, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp chili powder and ¾ tsp salt, mixing just until the ingredients hold together.

Form approximately 24 equal meatballs with lightly moistened hands and arrange on a clean plate. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and brown meatballs in batches for about 4 minutes, turning to color the surfaces; they will finish cooking in the sauce.

Finely dice the remaining half onion and mince 2 garlic cloves. Add them to the skillet and cook for 3 minutes, then add 2 cups crushed tomatoes, 1 cup beef broth, 1 chopped chipotle pepper, the remaining 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp chili powder and ½ tsp salt.

Return meatballs to the sauce, cover and simmer gently for 15–20 minutes, turning once, until their centers reach 160°F. If the sauce becomes too thick, stir in water by the tablespoon; keep the meatballs partly submerged.

Reheat 3 cups previously cooked rice until steaming and 165°F, following safe cooled-rice storage practices. Divide rice among six plates, spoon four meatballs and tomato-chile sauce onto each, and garnish with ¼ cup chopped cilantro.

recipes.name: Smoky Chipotle Turkey Chili
steps: Dice 1 onion and 1 bell pepper and mince 3 garlic cloves. Drain and rinse enough canned kidney and black beans to make 2 cups kidney beans and 1 cup black beans.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a heavy pot over medium heat. Add onion and bell pepper and cook 5 minutes until softened, then stir in the garlic for 30 seconds.

Add 1½ lb ground turkey, break into small pieces and cook 7–9 minutes until no pink remains and the turkey reaches 165°F. Stir in 2 tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tsp salt.

Finely mince 2 canned chipotle peppers and add them with 3 cups crushed tomatoes, 1 cup chicken broth and the drained beans. Bring to a low simmer, cover partly and cook 25–30 minutes, stirring occasionally so the bottom does not scorch.
Taste and adjust seasoning, then simmer uncovered an additional 5 minutes if you prefer a thicker chili. Ladle into six bowls and top each with about 2 tbsp shredded cheddar from the measured ¾ cup.

recipes.name: Steak Taco Salad
steps: Pat 1¼ lb flank steak dry and rub with 2 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp cumin, ¾ tsp salt and 1 tbsp olive oil. Let sit for 10 minutes while you prepare the remaining salad ingredients.

Rinse and dry 8 cups chopped romaine lettuce. Drain and rinse 1 cup black beans, dice 2 tomatoes, finely slice half a red onion and cube 1 avocado; keep avocado aside with a small squeeze of lime to limit browning.

Heat a grill pan over medium-high heat and cook the steak 4–6 minutes per side, according to thickness, until the thickest part reaches 145°F. Rest for at least 3 minutes, then slice thinly against the grain.

Warm 1 cup corn kernels in a dry skillet for 4–5 minutes, stirring until thoroughly hot and slightly browned. Whisk remaining 2 tbsp olive oil with juice of the limes and ¼ cup sour cream to make a pourable dressing.
Divide romaine, beans, corn, tomato, onion and avocado among four large salad bowls. Top evenly with sliced steak and ½ cup cotija cheese; drizzle the lime dressing on each salad just before serving.

recipes.name: Garlic Parmesan Chicken Wings

recipes.name: Classic Beef Stroganoff

Spread in a greased 9-by-13-inch baking dish and smooth the surface.

recipes.name: Garlic Butter Steak Bites and Potatoes
steps: Cut 1½ lb baby potatoes into halves and boil in salted water for 8–10 minutes until barely tender; drain and pat dry.

Heat 1 tbsp oil and 2 tbsp butter in a skillet; brown potatoes for 8 minutes, stirring occasionally. Remove to a plate.
Increase heat to medium-high and sear steak cubes in batches about 2 minutes per side until 145°F, then rest 3 minutes.
Reduce heat; melt remaining 2 tbsp butter with 5 minced garlic cloves for 30 seconds. Return steak and potatoes, toss, garnish with ¼ cup parsley and divide four ways.

steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and wash 2 leeks thoroughly; slice pale portions and dice 2 carrots
Melt 3 tbsp butter, soften leeks and carrots for 7 minutes, stir in ¼ cup flour for 1 minute
Whisk in 2 cups broth and 1 cup milk until thick; fold in 1½ lb cooked chicken and 1 cup peas
Pour filling into a baking dish and cover with a sheet of puff pastry, cutting slits for steam
Bake 25–30 minutes until pastry is deeply golden and filling reaches 165°F; rest 10 minutes

recipes.name: Baked Honey Mustard Chicken Thighs
steps: Heat oven to 400°F. Pat 2 lb boneless chicken thighs dry and spread in a single layer in a baking dish.
Whisk ¼ cup Dijon mustard, ¼ cup honey, 1 tbsp vinegar, 1 tbsp olive oil, 3 minced garlic cloves and 1 tsp thyme until smooth.
Pour sauce evenly over chicken, turning each piece to coat both sides.
Bake for 30–40 minutes, brushing with pan sauce halfway through, until the thickest thigh reaches 165°F.
Rest 5 minutes, spoon the hot sauce over the chicken and divide into four equal portions.

recipes.name: Creamy Tomato Basil Tortellini
steps: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a deep skillet over medium heat. Cook ½ chopped onion for 4 minutes and 4 minced garlic cloves for 30 seconds.
Stir in 28 oz crushed tomatoes and simmer uncovered 8 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add ¾ cup cream and gently simmer 2 minutes without boiling vigorously.
Stir in 20 oz refrigerated cheese tortellini; cover and cook according to package, about 5–7 minutes, adding ¼ cup water if sauce gets too thick.
Fold in ½ cup chopped basil and ½ cup Parmesan. Divide into four warmed bowls.

recipes.name: Ground Turkey Lettuce Wraps
steps: Separate and wash leaves from 1 head butter lettuce; pat dry and refrigerate until serving.
Heat 1 tbsp sesame oil over medium-high; add 1½ lb ground turkey and break into small pieces. Cook 7–9 minutes until 165°F.
Stir in 3 minced garlic cloves and 1 tbsp grated ginger and cook 30 seconds.
Add drained chopped 8 oz water chestnuts, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 3 tbsp hoisin and 1 tbsp rice vinegar. Cook 2–3 minutes until coated and heated through.
Spoon hot filling into lettuce leaves and top with 4 sliced green onions. Split evenly into four servings.

Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in wide skillet and brown sausage for 5 minutes, transfer to plate
Add cabbage and onion with ¼ cup water and cover 8 minutes to soften
Stir in apples, 2 tbsp cider vinegar and 1 tbsp Dijon; cook 5–7 minutes
Return sausage and heat thoroughly to 165°F, divide into six portions

recipes.name: Crispy Baked Fish Sticks
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Cut 1½ lb cod into 16 even strips and blot dry.
Arrange ½ cup flour in a bowl, whisk 2 eggs in another, and mix 1½ cups panko with 1 tsp paprika and 1 tsp garlic powder in a third.
Dredge strips in flour, dip in egg and press gently into seasoned panko.
Place on a parchment-lined baking sheet and drizzle evenly with 2 tbsp olive oil. Bake 15–20 minutes, turning once, until golden and fish reaches 145°F.
Serve four fish sticks per person with lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Broccoli Cheddar Stuffed Chicken
steps: Heat oven to 375°F. Steam 2 cups finely chopped broccoli for 3 minutes, drain and cool slightly.
Mix broccoli with 1 cup cheddar, 4 oz softened cream cheese and ½ tsp garlic powder.
Cut a deep pocket into each of four large chicken breasts totaling 2 lb, without cutting all the way through. Divide filling among pockets and secure openings with toothpicks.
Season chicken with ½ tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika and ½ tsp salt. Sear in 1 tbsp oil in an oven-safe skillet for 3 minutes per side.
Bake 15–25 minutes until chicken reaches 165°F. Remove toothpicks and rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Slow-Cooker White Chicken Chili
steps: Put 2 lb chicken breasts in slow cooker with 1 diced onion, two drained 15 oz cans white beans, 8 oz green chiles, 4 cups broth, 2 tsp cumin and 1 tsp chili powder.
Cover and cook on LOW for 5–6 hours, until chicken reaches 165°F and shreds easily.
Transfer chicken to a board, shred with forks and return to the slow cooker.
Cube 8 oz cream cheese, stir into hot chili and cook on HIGH 15–20 minutes until completely melted.
Add juice from 1 lime, stir well and divide into six bowls.

recipes.name: Italian Meatball Subs
steps: Heat oven to 400°F. Mix 1½ lb ground beef, ½ cup breadcrumbs, 1 egg, ¼ cup Parmesan, 1 tsp garlic powder and 1 tsp Italian seasoning just until combined.
Shape into 16 meatballs and arrange on a lined sheet pan; bake 18–22 minutes until centers reach 160°F.
Warm 2 cups marinara sauce in a saucepan and simmer baked meatballs in it for 5 minutes.
Split four hoagie rolls. Place four saucy meatballs in each and spoon on remaining sauce.
Top each with ¼ cup mozzarella and broil 1–2 minutes until melted, watching closely.

recipes.name: Roasted Vegetable and Chicken Orzo
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Chop 2 zucchini and 1 red onion; toss with 2 cups cherry tomatoes, 2 tbsp olive oil and ½ tsp oregano on a sheet pan.
Add 1½ lb diced chicken breasts seasoned with remaining ½ tsp oregano; roast 20–25 minutes, stirring halfway, until chicken reaches 165°F and vegetables brown at edges.
Meanwhile toast 1½ cups dry orzo in 1 tbsp oil in a saucepan for 1 minute.
Add 3 cups broth, bring to a simmer and cook uncovered 9–12 minutes, stirring until orzo is tender; add water as needed.
Fold roasted chicken and vegetables into cooked orzo. Top with ½ cup crumbled feta and divide into four bowls.

recipes.name: Balsamic Beef Short Ribs with Polenta
steps: Heat oven to 325°F. Sear 3 lb short ribs in Dutch oven over medium-high for 3 minutes per side
Remove ribs and soften one sliced onion and 4 minced garlic cloves for 5 minutes
Add ½ cup balsamic and 2 cups broth, return short ribs, cover and braise 2½–3 hours until fork tender
Cook 1 cup quick polenta in 2 cups milk and 2 cups water per package and stir in ½ cup Parmesan
Spoon polenta into six bowls and top with ribs and braising juices

recipes.name: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Linguine
steps: Boil 12 oz linguine until al dente, reserving ½ cup of the starchy water before draining.
Pat 1½ lb shrimp dry. Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet and sauté shrimp for 2 minutes per side until opaque and 145°F; remove to a plate.
Reduce heat and melt 3 tbsp butter, cook 5 minced garlic cloves and ¼ tsp red pepper flakes for 30 seconds.
Add juice from 2 lemons and ¼ cup reserved pasta water; swirl until saucy.
Toss in pasta, shrimp and ¼ cup chopped parsley, adding more water if needed. Divide into four portions.

recipes.name: Salisbury Steak with Mushroom Gravy
steps: Mix 1½ lb beef, ½ cup breadcrumbs, 1 egg and 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce; shape into four oval patties.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium heat; brown patties for 4 minutes on each side, then transfer to a plate.
Add sliced onion and 8 oz sliced mushrooms, sautéing 6 minutes until softened.
Whisk 1½ tbsp cornstarch into ¼ cup cold broth; pour remaining 1¾ cups broth and 1 tbsp Worcestershire into the pan, then add slurry and simmer until thickened.
Return patties to gravy and simmer 7–10 minutes until centers reach 160°F. Serve each patty with mushroom gravy.

recipes.name: Ham and Cheese Breakfast Sliders
steps: Heat oven to 350°F. Slice a connected pack of 12 dinner rolls horizontally and place bottom slab in a greased baking dish.
Whisk 6 eggs with ¼ cup milk; scramble in a nonstick skillet over medium heat until set and 160°F.
Layer 12 oz ham, cooked eggs and 6 Swiss slices over bottom rolls; replace top slab.
Melt 3 tbsp butter, mix with 1 tbsp Dijon and brush over the tops.
Cover with foil and bake 12 minutes, then uncover 5–8 minutes until cheese melts. Cut into 12 sliders and serve two per portion.

recipes.name: One-Pan Creamy Garlic Chicken and Rice
steps: Season 1½ lb chicken thighs with 1 tsp Italian seasoning. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a deep skillet and brown thighs 3 minutes per side; remove.
Sauté 5 minced garlic cloves for 30 seconds, then stir in 1½ cups rinsed rice, 3 cups broth and ½ cup cream.
Return chicken over rice and bring to a simmer; cover and cook on low for 18–22 minutes until rice is tender.
Check chicken at the thickest part for 165°F; continue cooking if needed, adding a splash of water if rice dries out.
Fold 2 cups spinach into hot rice until wilted, rest covered 5 minutes, then divide four ways.

recipes.name: Beef and Bean Chili
steps: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large pot and soften 1 diced onion and 1 diced bell pepper for 6 minutes.
Add 2 lb ground beef; break it up and brown for 8–10 minutes until 160°F, draining excess fat.
Stir in 2 tbsp chili powder and 2 tsp cumin for 30 seconds.
Add two drained 15 oz cans kidney beans, 28 oz crushed tomatoes and 15 oz tomato sauce. Bring to a simmer.
Cook partially covered for 35–40 minutes, stirring every 10 minutes until thick, and divide into six bowls.

Heat a lightly oiled nonstick skillet over medium and cook patties 5–7 minutes per side until 165°F
Toast four buns and divide 2 cups spinach among bottom halves
Add turkey patties, close buns and serve while warm

recipes.name: Pork Tenderloin with Apple Pan Sauce
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Pat 1½ lb pork tenderloin dry; heat 1 tbsp oil in an oven-safe skillet and sear on all sides for 5 minutes total.
Transfer skillet to oven and roast 15–22 minutes until pork reaches 145°F; move to board and rest 3 minutes.

Pour 1 cup apple cider into the pan and scrape browned bits; add 1 tbsp Dijon and 1 tsp thyme, then simmer 5 minutes until slightly reduced.
Slice pork into medallions and divide among four plates; spoon apple and onion sauce on top.

steps: Preheat oven to 400°F and grease a baking dish with 1 tbsp olive oil.
Mix 1½ lb ground chicken, ¾ cup breadcrumbs, 1 egg, ½ cup Parmesan and 1 tsp Italian seasoning; shape into 20 meatballs.
Arrange on a lined baking sheet and bake 15–18 minutes until centers reach 165°F.
Pour 2 cups marinara into the greased dish and add baked meatballs; sprinkle with 1 cup mozzarella.

recipes.name: Breakfast Potato and Chorizo Hash
steps: Dice 1½ lb potatoes into ½-inch cubes and boil in salted water 6 minutes; drain and dry.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a skillet and cook diced onion and pepper 4 minutes. Add 12 oz fresh chorizo, crumble and cook until 160°F.
Add cooked potatoes and 1 tsp smoked paprika; sauté 8–10 minutes until golden and crisp, turning gently.

Garnish with ¼ cup chopped cilantro and divide the hash so each serving has one egg.

Add 1½ lb fully cooked shredded chicken; warm to 165°F and garnish with ¼ cup dill

Brown 1½ lb beef with 1 diced onion until beef reaches 160°F; drain

steps: Heat oven to 400°F; whisk ¾ cup orange juice, 3 tbsp soy sauce, 3 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp ginger and 3 minced garlic cloves
Reserve half the sauce in a clean saucepan; brush pork with remaining half
Roast tenderloin 20–25 minutes until center reaches 145°F

steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and cook 12 manicotti shells according to package until pliable
Brown 1¼ lb ground turkey to 165°F; wilt 4 cups spinach into hot turkey
Mix turkey and spinach with 1½ cups ricotta and 1 tsp Italian seasoning
Fill shells with mixture and arrange over 1 cup marinara in baking dish
Pour remaining 2 cups marinara on top, sprinkle 1½ cups mozzarella, cover and bake 25 minutes; uncover 5 minutes

recipes.name: Thai Basil Beef Rice
steps: Rinse and cook 1½ cups jasmine rice using package water ratio
Whisk 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp oyster sauce and 1 tbsp brown sugar
Cook 1½ lb ground beef in a hot skillet 7–9 minutes until 160°F and drain excess grease
Stir in 5 minced garlic cloves and 2 sliced peppers; cook 4 minutes
Add sauce and 1 cup basil leaves; toss until wilted and serve over rice in four portions

recipes.name: Rosemary Garlic Turkey Meatloaf
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and grease a loaf pan
Mix 2 lb ground turkey, 2 eggs, ¾ cup breadcrumbs, ½ cup milk, 1 diced onion, 3 minced garlic cloves and 1 tbsp rosemary
Shape firmly into loaf pan without compacting too tightly
Spread ½ cup ketchup evenly on top and bake 50–60 minutes until center reaches 165°F
Rest 10 minutes before cutting into eight equal slices

recipes.name: Coconut Lime Chicken Curry
steps: Cook 1½ cups jasmine rice according to package directions
Heat a deep skillet, cook 1 diced onion and 2 sliced peppers for 5 minutes
Stir in 2 tbsp red curry paste and 1 tbsp grated ginger for 1 minute
Add 1½ lb diced chicken thighs and 14 oz coconut milk; simmer covered for 15–18 minutes until chicken reaches 165°F
Finish with juice from 2 limes and spoon over rice in four servings

recipes.name: Smoky Ham and Navy Bean Soup
steps: Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large soup pot and soften diced onion, 3 carrots and 3 celery stalks for 7 minutes
Add 1 tsp smoked paprika and stir 30 seconds
Add 7 cups broth, three drained 15 oz cans navy beans and 1½ lb fully cooked ham
Simmer partially covered for 25 minutes until vegetables soften
Mash ½ cup beans to thicken, rewarm ham to 165°F and divide into six bowls

recipes.name: Crispy Ranch Potato Wedges with Chicken
steps: Heat oven to 425°F and cut 2 lb scrubbed potatoes into thick wedges
Toss wedges with 2 tbsp oil, 1 tbsp ranch seasoning and 1 tsp paprika; roast 20 minutes
Toss 1½ lb chicken tenders with remaining 1 tbsp oil and 1 tbsp ranch seasoning
Add chicken to a separate lined pan and roast both pans another 15–20 minutes, until chicken reaches 165°F and potatoes brown
Whisk ½ cup yogurt with 1 tbsp lemon juice for dip; divide chicken and wedges four ways

recipes.name: Creamy Spinach and Artichoke Chicken Bake
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and lightly grease a baking dish
Spread 1½ lb chicken breast cutlets in a single layer
Mix 14 oz drained chopped artichokes, 4 cups chopped spinach, 6 oz softened cream cheese, 1 cup mozzarella and 3 minced garlic cloves
Spread mixture over chicken and sprinkle with ½ cup Parmesan
Bake 30–35 minutes until thickest chicken reaches 165°F, rest 5 minutes and divide four ways

recipes.name: Apricot Glazed Pork Meatballs
steps: Heat oven to 400°F and line a sheet pan
Mix 1½ lb ground pork, ½ cup breadcrumbs and 1 egg, then shape into 20 meatballs
Bake for 16–20 minutes until meatballs reach 160°F
While baking, simmer ½ cup apricot preserves with 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp rice vinegar and 1 tbsp grated ginger for 4 minutes
Coat cooked meatballs in glaze, garnish with 3 sliced green onions and serve five per person

recipes.name: Butternut Squash Sausage Risotto
steps: Warm 5 cups broth in a saucepan; cube 1½ lb peeled squash into small pieces
Brown 1 lb sausage in a heavy skillet until 160°F; transfer to a plate
Melt 2 tbsp butter, cook diced onion 4 minutes, stir in 1½ cups Arborio rice and toast 2 minutes
Add warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring often; add squash after 10 minutes and continue adding broth for 20–25 minutes total until rice and squash are tender
Fold in sausage, ¾ cup Parmesan and 1 tbsp chopped sage; divide into six bowls

recipes.name: Honey Sesame Salmon Rice Bowls
steps: Cook 1½ cups dry brown rice according to package, usually 35–40 minutes
Heat oven to 400°F and place four salmon portions on lined baking tray
Whisk 3 tbsp honey, 3 tbsp soy sauce and 2 tbsp rice vinegar; brush half over salmon
Bake salmon for 12–18 minutes until 145°F and brush with reserved clean sauce
Divide rice into bowls, add salmon, 1 sliced cucumber, 2 shredded carrots and 2 tbsp sesame seeds

recipes.name: Chicken and Corn Chowder
steps: Melt 2 tbsp butter in a soup pot and soften 1 diced onion for 5 minutes
Stir in ¼ cup flour for 1 minute then gradually whisk in 5 cups broth and 2 cups milk
Add 1 lb diced potatoes and 1½ lb diced chicken; simmer 15–18 minutes, stirring often
Add 4 cups corn and cook 6–8 minutes more until potatoes soften and chicken reaches 165°F
Mash some potatoes against pot to thicken, stir and divide into six servings

recipes.name: Crispy Oven Barbecue Pork Ribs
steps: Preheat oven to 300°F and remove membrane from underside of 3 lb ribs
Mix 2 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tsp garlic powder, and rub over both sides
Set ribs on foil-lined tray, add 2 tbsp vinegar, wrap tightly in foil and bake 2½–3 hours until tender
Open foil carefully, brush ribs with 1 cup barbecue sauce, and raise oven to 425°F
Bake uncovered 10–15 minutes to caramelize; rest 10 minutes, cut into four portions and serve

recipes.name: Cheddar Bacon Broccoli Quiche
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F and fit one pastry crust into a 9-inch pie pan
Cook 6 bacon slices crisp; crumble, and steam 2 cups broccoli 3 minutes
Whisk 6 eggs with 1 cup half-and-half and stir in 1½ cups cheddar and ½ diced onion
Arrange broccoli and bacon in crust, then pour egg mixture on top
Bake 35–45 minutes until center reaches 160°F and is set; rest 10 minutes and cut into six slices

recipes.name: Garlic Chili Noodles with Ground Pork
steps: Soak or boil 12 oz rice noodles following package directions; drain
Whisk ¼ cup soy sauce, 2 tbsp chili garlic sauce and 2 tbsp brown sugar with ¼ cup water
Heat 1 tbsp sesame oil in wok; brown 1½ lb ground pork 8 minutes until 160°F
Add 5 minced garlic cloves for 30 seconds, then pour in sauce and simmer 2 minutes
Toss noodles with meat and sauce, garnish with 4 sliced green onions and divide into four bowls

recipes.name: Cider Braised Chicken with Apples
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F; brown 2½ lb thighs skin-side down in 1 tbsp oil for 6 minutes and turn for 2 minutes
Remove chicken and sauté 1 sliced onion and 2 apple wedges for 4 minutes
Add 1½ cups cider, 1 cup broth, 1 tbsp Dijon and 1 tbsp chopped thyme; simmer 2 minutes
Nestle chicken into liquid and bake uncovered 25–35 minutes until it reaches 165°F
Rest chicken 5 minutes and divide apples, sauce and meat among four plates

steps: Cook 16 oz potato gnocchi in boiling water according to package; drain when they float
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a skillet and sauté 1½ lb raw shrimp for 2–3 minutes per side until opaque and 145°F; remove
Add 2 cups halved cherry tomatoes and cook for 3 minutes until softened
Stir in ½ cup pesto and ½ cup cream; simmer 2 minutes, then fold in gnocchi and cooked shrimp
Sprinkle ½ cup Parmesan and divide into four bowls
